issue.title: Retire the legacy bob-copy-chips plugin id now that every host deploys bob-chips

task_type_fields.proposal:
Retire the legacy `bob-copy-chips` plugin id now that every desktop host deploys `bob-chips`. The command-chip epic (bob-cli-nu, design choice 1) dual-listed both ids during the transition. `bob plugins sync` has no notion of retired ids, so the old id still lingers.

State verified by the bob-cli-nu land agent on 2026-11-20:
- The chezmoi `plugins.sync` allowlist (b19c116c) lists only `bob-chips`, and that config is applied on apollo, athena, and the Mac.
- `bob-chips` is deployed on apollo (0.14.0), the Mac (0.14.0), and athena (0.10.0, stale until `bob plugins sync` runs there).
- `~/bob/.obsidian/plugins/bob-copy-chips/` still exists on athena (and likely on the other hosts).

Scope:
1. Vault: remove "bob-copy-chips" from `.obsidian/community-plugins.json`. Keep the `.gitignore` line, because stale folders must stay ignored. Commit only that file.
2. Each host: delete the stale `~/bob/.obsidian/plugins/bob-copy-chips/` folder. These folders are per-host and gitignored. Ask Bryan before touching the Mac if it is unreachable.
3. bob-plugins:
   - drop the double-load guard in `plugins/bob-chips/src/090-plugin.js` and its test in `scripts/test-copy-chips-grammar.cjs`;
   - drop the `plugins["bob-copy-chips"]` fallback in `plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/641-plugin-copy-card.js` and its fixture in `scripts/test-navigation-copy-card-view.cjs`;
   - update the retired-id note in `docs/develop/plugin-apis.md` and the comment in `plugins/bob-chips/src/060-reading.js`;
   - bump the versions, run `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run validate`, and `npm run docs:check`, then run `bob plugins sync`.
4. Keep the bob-cli `mkdocs.yml` redirect `reference/plugins/bob-copy-chips.md -> reference/plugins/bob-chips.md`, because published URLs are preserved.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-nu plan deliberately left retirement as a recorded follow-up (design choice 1 and the rename phase's report step, bob-cli-nu.1 note #1). Removing the old id before every host had synced would have dropped chips on hosts that had not yet updated. The epic's own scope ended at the dual-listed transition.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-nu.1 (note #1) and triaged by the bob-cli-nu land agent; the epic's planned dual-listed transition is complete on all three hosts, so the old id, guard, and fallback can go.
